topics.label: Introduction and Lecture Overview
topics.groupedBecause: This topic introduces the cancer biology lecture series and outlines the core learning outcomes for the session.

topics.label: Cellular and Genetic Basis of Cancer Development
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics explain how accumulated genetic and epigenetic changes disrupt normal cellular differentiation and tissue architecture to initiate tumor growth.

topics.label: Benign and Malignant Tumors, Progression, and Nomenclature
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics define how tumors are distinguished, graded, and classified based on invasion, metastatic potential, histological progression, and formal naming conventions.

topics.label: Pathological Mechanisms of Cancer Morbidity and Mortality
topics.groupedBecause: This subtopic explains the direct mechanical, physiological, and systemic processes through which tumors cause disease and patient death.

topics.label: Epidemiology and Cross-Species Incidence of Tumors
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics compare the incidence and mortality rates of different tumor types across human tissues and throughout diverse animal species.

topics.label: Principles and Modalities of Cancer Screening
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics assess the clinical rationale, diagnostic methods, and relative success rates of screening programs across various cancer types.

topics.label: Conclusion and Wrap-Up
topics.groupedBecause: This topic closes the lecture by referencing the learning outcomes and providing housekeeping details for upcoming sessions.
